### Porch Group Announces Attendance at Upcoming Investor Events


November 2, 2026


SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Porch Group, Inc. (“Porch”) (Nasdaq: PRCH), a new kind of homeowners insurance company, today announced its upcoming investor event attendance.


Porch Management will be attending and participating in one-on-one and group investor meetings at these upcoming events:


- November 10, 2026: 2026 BMO Financials Conference (Boca Raton)
- November 11, 2026: 2026 Cantor Convergence Conference (Miami)
- November 16, 2026: Raymond James Sonoma Small Cap Summit (Sonoma)
- November 17, 2026: 17 th Annual Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference (New York City)
- November 18, 2026: Stephens Inc. Annual Investment Conference | NASH2026 (Nashville)
- November 20, 2026: Texas Capital Non-Deal Roadshow (Dallas/Fort Worth)
- November 23, 2026: Furey Research Hidden Gems Conference (Virtual)
- December 3, 2026: Stephens Inc. Non-Deal Roadshow (New York City)


These investor events and future events can be found on our website[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.porchgroup.com%2Finvestors%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54630122&newsitemid=20261102532085&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=f8eb16c09d09f4aa40278f070d95d84b) .


**About Porch Group**


Porch Group, Inc., ("Porch") is a new kind of homeowners insurance company. Porch's strategy to win in homeowners insurance is to deploy leading vertical software solutions in select home-related industries, provide the best services for homebuyers including important moving services, leverage unique data for advantaged underwriting, and provide more protection for policyholders.


To learn more about Porch, visit ir.porchgroup.com.
